For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 18/07/2023 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.28/2023 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Jaisalmer for the offences under Sections 498A and 304B IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Mahila Thana, District Jaisalmer
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that deceased - Mst. 'K' committed suicide within two years of marriage by consuming poison.
Learned counsel submitted that deceased was living separately from the present petitioner from the last 7-8 months.

Learned counsel submitted that there is no evidence available on record indicating that deceased was subjected to cruelty or harassment in connection with demand of dowry soon (2 of 2) [CRLMB-8696/2023] before her death.

Learned counsel submitted that in view of the fact that deceased was living separately and there is no evidence available on record indicating that deceased was subjected to cruelty or harassment in connection with demand of dowry, the petitioner deserves to be enlarged on bail.
Learned counsel submitted that challan has already been filed; the petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner - Bhaarmal @ Bhaarmalram S/o Shri Kishnaram arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.28/2023 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Jaisalmer shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
